content:
While iOS 27 has been the main focus of preview software, Apple is still preparing iOS 26.6 as the next iPhone update. Apple has already released the first release candidate of iOS 26.6. The iOS 26.6 beta has been in testing since the end of May.

iOS 26.6 Features and Changes

So far, we have spotted two notable changes in the iOS 26.6 beta.

First, there is a change to the limit on the number of contacts that can be blocked. Second, it appears a new iPhone anti-theft feature is in development.

This update may also be laying the groundwork for Spotlight indexing on iPhone and iPad so Siri AI can use it in iOS 27. Today's release candidate confirmed this for the first time publicly in its release notes.

Given that all attention has now shifted to iOS 27, we do not expect there to be many other new features or changes.

Apple's next major software update will roll out to users in September, when Apple will continue refining iOS 27 throughout the summer.

iOS 26.6 will be the next version to be officially released, following iOS 26, which launched last fall, and its subsequent updates.

Last year, iOS 18.6 beta 1 came out after iOS 26 beta 1. This means iOS 26.6 is slightly ahead of where Apple was in its 2025 release cycle.
